**(1) Grand Hyatt bridge.**
- The spec's own Commons reference photo of the station shows the stained-glass station level directly under the guideway deck. The 2019 press release says the bridge runs from the station, via that stained glass, to the 4th-floor lobby.
- So the bridge now runs at the hotel's 4th-floor line (14.0 m), under the deck, along the whole outline finger to the station footprint. Its roof sits 0.15 m below the deck soffit.
- The hotel's storey heights did not change. They already agree with the published 4th-floor connection. The round-6 19.75 m level was an inferred network level, not a published fact.
- Measured: no clash with the AirTrain, roads or other buildings at any LOD; verify_landside 209 checks, 0 failed.

**(3) Fold gates.** Both roadway fold gates now fail the build. b3d_integrate also raises a conflict when the manifest's fold-gate flag is false.

- Ring 82 is the BART station complex. Its plan comes from OSM, cross-checked with NAIP. Most of it is elevated: only 200 m2 stands on the ground; the rest starts 5.9 m or 15.5 m above grade.
- The three aircraft reference points are all on the landside, 390-692 m from any taxiway. So the problem is the aircraft positions, not the footprints. The request back to the realtime track is in integration_closeout R7.3.
